title: Training Layers
definition: The two-stage approach to successful personality training: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

difficulty_levels.beginner: Successful personality training involves two stages: first, teaching the model the basics (SFT), then refining its preferences (DPO).
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A two-stage process consisting of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to establish the model's foundation, followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to sharpen its boundaries and preferences.
difficulty_levels.expert: A two-stage process that follows a consistent recipe: first, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to teach the model roughly 'what this personality looks like,' and then Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to answer 'which phrasing is more in-character' and learn which one to prefer.

extra_fields.insight: The success recipe for personality training consists of two stages: SFT to build the foundation and DPO to sharpen the boundaries.
